reports.title: Encounter laboratory report
reports.availability: Existing patient-held report. Matching requests and firm recommendations/plans/orders release only the relevant supplied tests under the case's same-visit scripted-result convention. It is not a newly completed test.

reports.title: Left foot X-ray written report
reports.availability: Existing patient-held written report. A matching request or firm recommendation/plan/order releases it in the same response. Preserve the report date. No radiograph image exists.
reports.prior_evaluation_context: Current foot/toe complaint: prior-assessment questions may elicit that she has had an X-ray and holds its report, without disclosing contents until a result trigger. No prior clinician, facility, visit date, or advice is supplied.

reports.title: Historical laboratory panels
reports.availability: Historical records only: complete blood count, comprehensive metabolic panel, lipid panel, hemoglobin A1C, and thyroid panel. Deliver the relevant existing record on request only if not already supplied to the learner. A new order does not turn these historical panels into current results. Not eligible for recall variation.
